patch.summary: ClickUp implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement ClickUp by mapping current project-management workflows to ClickUp objects, confirming plan gates for AI assistance (Free Forever, Unlimited, Business, Business Plus, Enterprise), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Slack, Google Workspace, Github) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: AI assistance (Free Forever, Unlimited, Business, Business Plus, Enterprise)
Integrate after: data quality pass on Slack

blocks.heading: ClickUp day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat ClickUp setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for task boards, timeline / Gantt, workload and resources before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Teams consolidating tasks+docs+dashboards before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Slack and Google Workspace before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover AI assistance (Free Forever, Unlimited, Business, Business Plus, Enterprise)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Configuration sprawl without admin standards
Do not expand seats until task boards is green

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: AI Brain packaging can add cost beyond Unlimited floors

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Steeper onboarding than Asana for non-technical teams

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: ClickUp plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Free Forever

blocks.title: Validate project-management fit before a deep ClickUp rollout
blocks.body: If ClickUp fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft ClickUp object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on task boards
If blocked, evaluate Asana before sunk-cost expansion
